text:
sara: heads-up — CI turned red on my PR (4823) after the toolchain bump. typecheck job fails with pyright import resolution errors. full build: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4823

ci-bot: Build failed: job 'typecheck' exited with status 1. Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4823/logs

ben: looking now. can you paste the pyright error from the logs? :mag_right:

sara: sure — copy from CI:
```
src/redwood/serve/_router.py:10: error: Cannot find module named 'redwood.runtime.kvstore'
  import redwood.runtime.kvstore as kv
```

maria: that import used to resolve from the packaging reorg. did you rebase onto the refactor that moved runtime packages? which commit are you on?

sara: rebased onto main at 0f3a9c2 (toolchain/packaging bump). I didn't touch imports in serve.

ben: quick try: run an editable install and local typecheck to match CI layout:
```
python -m pip install -e .
tools/typecheck --local
```

sara: ran that locally, still the same error. pyright only resolves if I add an explicit package shim (runtime/__init__.py) which feels wrong.

maria: sounds like pyright's module resolution root differs from pytest/packaging. two quick options: 1) update pyrightconfig to include extraPaths for /workspace/src, or 2) add a short CI step to run `pip install -e .` before typecheck so the editable package is present.

alex: could also be a flaky CI worker with stale venv/cache. @ci-bot can you rerun build 4823 typecheck job?

ci-bot: @alex Rerun requested for build 4823 (typecheck). Job queued on runner r-5.

ben: if rerun still fails, we should bisect the last set of merges (packaging-reorg, toolchain-bump). pinging @maria to take a quick look at packaging-reorg changes.

maria: on it — I'll diff packaging-reorg against main for any __init__ removals or namespace changes. if necessary I'll open a tiny shim PR to restore pyright compatibility.

sara: thanks all — I can hold the PR merge if this is blocking others. please @mention me on the bisect result. :pray:
